metadata.description: Claude Code plugins built for daily use, then generalised for release: a model-aware prompt generator, a token and context waste auditor, and three standalone tools.

plugins.name: promptcarta
plugins.description: Model-aware prompt generator and critic. Resolves the exact target model, reads its behaviour from dated reference files rather than memory, applies a model-specific transform, scans for constructs that now return HTTP 400, and re-scores the result.

plugins.name: context-till
plugins.description: Surfaces token and context waste at the end of each turn. Reports only what its hooks actually measured, never an estimate.

plugins.name: entity-naming
plugins.description: Company and brand name generation with live RDAP domain clearance and India registry/trademark lookups, scored against a fixed rubric.

plugins.name: sketcher
plugins.description: Turn room dimensions into a to-scale 2D SVG floor plan with accessibility and egress clearance checks (ADA/IBC or India NBC 2016).

plugins.name: risk-critic
plugins.description: Adversarial review pair: risk-critic surfaces risks in work just produced and is not permitted to propose fixes; remediation-planner answers each with a quick fix, a structural fix, a trade-off and a verification command, and is not permitted to raise new risks.
